note: Video game releases checked against Rockstar, Take-Two, PlayStation Store, PlayStation Blog, Xbox Wire, the Xbox Store, Halo Support, the Xbox Game Studios Shop, Nintendo, the official Fable site, and the official Tomb Raider site. A USD price is stored only when that page states one. A day that is not announced is TBA. No sold price was invented.

items.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
items.platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S
items.retailSource: PlayStation Store and Take-Two press release
items.spot: Launch November 19, 2026. Standard edition is $79.99 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Digital pre-load starts November 12, 2026. The physical box is a download code, not a disc, and is scheduled from November 12, 2026. Pre-orders and purchases before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.
items.photoAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI official cover art

items.name: Grand Theft Auto VI Ultimate Edition
items.platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S
items.retailSource: PlayStation Store and Take-Two press release
items.spot: Ultimate Edition is $99.99 and adds the Ultimate Edition upgrade on top of the standard game. Take-Two says a physical Ultimate Edition box is not sold. Pre-orders before November 20, 2026 include the Vintage Vice City Pack.
items.photoAlt: Grand Theft Auto VI official cover art

items.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, PlayStation 5
items.spot: Standard Edition is $49.99 and includes the base game. Global launch was July 28, 2026 at 8am PDT, July 29 in Japan and some Asia-Pacific markets. Also on Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass.
items.photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved official key art

items.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved Premium Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, PlayStation 5
items.spot: Premium Edition is $69.99. It includes up to five days of early access beginning July 23, 2026, the Alpha Halo Armory Pack, and the digital story and art collection. Launch day is July 28, 2026.
items.photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved official key art

items.name: Halo: Campaign Evolved Collector's Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X, PlayStation 5, Steam
items.spot: Collector's Edition is $199.99 and includes a Steelbook, a 12-inch Master Chief statue, an LED Cortana chip, concept-art prints, and a disc for Xbox Series X and PlayStation 5. Steam is a code. Halo Support says it is sold out with no restock planned. Early access began July 23, 2026.
items.photoAlt: Halo: Campaign Evolved Collector's Edition box

items.name: Gears of War: E-Day
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, Game Pass
items.spot: Standard pre-order is $69.99. Xbox Wire dates the global release to October 6, 2026. Included with Game Pass.
items.photoAlt: Gears of War: E-Day official image from Xbox Wire

items.name: Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Steam, Game Pass
items.spot: Premium Edition pre-order is $99.99 on the Xbox Store. The global game date on Xbox Wire is October 6, 2026. The Collector's Edition, not this digital premium listing, is the October 1 early-access box.
items.photoAlt: Gears of War: E-Day official image from Xbox Wire

items.name: Gears of War: E-Day Collector's Edition
items.dateLabel: October 1, 2026 early access · game launches October 6, 2026
items.platforms: Xbox Series X, Steam
items.spot: Collector's Edition is $299.99. It includes the Premium Edition on an Xbox Series X disc, a Steelbook, a 15-inch Marcus and Dom statue, replica COG tags, and an art print. Early access is October 1, 2026. The game's global release is October 6, 2026. Quantities are limited.
items.photoAlt: Gears of War: E-Day Collector's Edition

items.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
items.platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam, Nintendo Switch 2
items.spot: Standard Edition is $59.99 and includes the game plus the Survivor Outfit pre-order bonus. PlayStation Blog dates the PS5 launch to February 12, 2027, and February 13 in Japan, Asia, Australia, and New Zealand. The publisher also lists Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2.
items.photoAlt: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis key art

items.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Deluxe Edition
items.platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam
items.spot: Deluxe Edition is $69.99. PlayStation Blog says it adds 48-hour early access, the Parisian Fugitive Outfit, and a post-launch story pack on top of the standard game.
items.photoAlt: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis key art

items.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Collector's Edition
items.platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Steam
items.spot: The publisher lists a Collector's Edition with a premium steel case, a Lara Croft versus T-Rex statue, a mini art book, a pin, and a talisman keychain, on top of the Deluxe Edition. The same page does not state a USD price. Switch 2 pre-orders were not open on that page.
items.photoAlt: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis key art

items.name: Final Fantasy XIV Online Complete Collector's Edition
items.platforms: Nintendo Switch 2
items.spot: Nintendo lists this Switch 2 Complete Collector's Edition at $139.99 with a release date of August 4, 2026. It includes the base game, expansions through Dawntrail, collector in-game items, and a 30-day play period. A paid subscription is required after that period.
items.photoAlt: Final Fantasy XIV Online Complete Collector's Edition for Nintendo Switch 2

items.name: Fable
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Game Pass
items.retailSource: Fable official site and Xbox Wire
items.spot: The official site says Fable is coming February 23, 2027. Xbox Wire says Premium Edition early access begins February 18, 2027. The site does not list a USD price.
items.photoAlt: Fable Standard Edition box art

items.name: Fable Collector's Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC
items.spot: The official site lists a Collector's Edition with a hardcover art book, a Steelbook, and a lapel pin, and says it includes the Premium Edition. The page marks it sold out and does not list a USD price. Premium early access begins February 18, 2027.
items.photoAlt: Fable Collector's Edition statue

items.name: God of War Laufey
items.platforms: PlayStation 5
items.spot: PlayStation Store lists the standard edition at $69.99. PlayStation Blog dates the PS5 launch to February 16, 2027. Pre-orders include the Last Wish armor set, a cosmetic, and a resource pack.
items.photoAlt: God of War Laufey key art

items.name: God of War Laufey Digital Deluxe Edition
items.platforms: PlayStation 5
items.spot: PlayStation Store lists the Digital Deluxe Edition at $79.99. PlayStation Blog says it adds the Dark Alchemy set, a digital art book, and the digital soundtrack. Launch is February 16, 2027.
items.photoAlt: God of War Laufey key art

items.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
items.platforms: PlayStation 5
items.spot: PlayStation Store lists the standard edition at $69.99. PlayStation Blog dates the PS5 launch to April 8, 2027. Pre-orders include the Mecha-Chocobo and Moogle summon materia.
items.photoAlt: Final Fantasy VII Revelation key art

items.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation Premium Edition
items.platforms: PlayStation 5
items.spot: PlayStation Store lists the Premium Edition at $99.99. The store page says 24-hour early access begins April 7, 2027 at 00:00, and the edition includes the Story Expansion Pass. The game launches April 8, 2027.
items.photoAlt: Final Fantasy VII Revelation key art

items.name: Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X
items.spot: Xbox Wire prices the 25th anniversary collection at $899.99 and dates the launch to November 13, 2026. Xbox.com says the 1TB Series X25 includes the X25 Special Edition controller, an engraved numbered console, and Halo: Campaign Evolved. Pre-orders are limited to one per customer.
items.photoAlt: Xbox Series X25 Limited Edition with the X25 controller

items.name: Xbox Wireless Controller X25 Special Edition
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox One, Windows, Bluetooth
items.spot: Xbox Wire says the X25 Special Edition controller launches October 20, 2026 and is sold separately from the console collection. The controller page does not print a USD price.
items.photoAlt: Xbox Wireless Controller X25 Special Edition

items.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Battle.net
items.spot: The Xbox Games Showcase 2026 recap says Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches October 23. It does not print a USD price or name a store SKU. Platforms listed there are Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, cloud, and Battle.net.

items.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Game Pass
items.spot: The Xbox Games Showcase 2026 recap says Minecraft Dungeons II arrives September 29. It does not print a USD price. A pre-order includes two hero skins, the Twisted cape, and the Twisted chicken pet.

items.name: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Game Pass
items.spot: Xbox Wire says Spyro: A Realm Beyond takes flight in Spring 2027. No day and no USD price are on that page.

items.name: State of Decay 3
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Game Pass
items.spot: Xbox Wire says State of Decay 3 is coming in 2027. No day and no USD price are on that page.

items.name: Persona 6
items.platforms: Xbox Series X|S, Xbox on PC, Game Pass
items.spot: Xbox Wire announced Persona 6 at Games Showcase 2026 and did not give a release day or a USD price.
